claim: With AWS Backup you can create two types of backups of S3 buckets, including object data, tags, access control lists (ACLs) and user-defined metadata: continuous backups, which allow restore to any point in time within the last 35 days, and periodic backups, which use snapshots to retain data for your specified duration up to 99 years.

evidence.quote: With AWS Backup, you can create the following types of backups of your S3 buckets, including object data, tags, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and user-defined metadata:
**Continuous backups** allow you to restore to any point in time within the last 35 days.
**Periodic backups** use snapshots of your data to allow you to retain data for your specified duration up to 99 years.
